scope: A100 engineering acceptance only; user explicitly authorized publication to credit-grok and poweroff after verification and upload
legacy_implementations: v3_fp32_fast and v3_engineering_fast_20261113 remain byte-identical to upstream; a separate launcher supplies local paths and records every override
revision_history: r1 retained rejected BF16 numeric evidence and the W&B duplicate-field export error. r2 repairs table export, records selected-device memory, and uses new candidate/output fingerprints; original numeric gates and objectives unchanged.

reference_prompts.source: Verified E4 archived train/base episodes; first four r0 files in archive order, turns 1,5,10,20 clipped to the episode length
reference_prompts.use: Prompt text only for numeric/performance comparison. Old responses, logprobs, rewards and advantages are never used as new A100 training data.

candidate_order: First identical BF16 runs on both GPUs, then independent FP32 candidates. Evaluate all candidates before selection.
selection: Highest measured generated tokens/second among candidates passing original HF/vLLM numeric gates. Freeze config and fingerprint before collecting engineering trajectories. A later failed gate requires a new revision/output directory; never mix candidate scores.

optimizer.reference: frozen original base via adapter disabling
optimizer.batch_population: all response steps including zero advantage; same denominator and optimizer schedule

cpu_cold_start: Verify the original P0/P1 archive and re-run the unchanged original offline gate on 768 P0 train episodes plus the original CTHA round-0 episodes. Never substitute synthetic data. Raw files arrived and passed manifest verification during preparation, before final configuration freeze.
device_plan: Independent single-GPU candidates and repeated collections. No DDP or tensor parallelism. One GPU for the four-step probe; dependent updated-policy sampling starts only after a verified checkpoint.
telemetry: W&B project ForkAudit, engineering group. Log four optimizer steps and candidate throughput/parity tables; offline files are retained until authentication permits sync. Never log checkpoint tensors.
publication: Only credit-grok; preserve old results; retain model/optimizer binaries locally with hashes; verify remote commit and sync before authorized poweroff
